top_signals.title: Just one in three Americans back Iran war, most unsure of Trump’s goals, poll finds
top_signals.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 69% of Americans think President Donald Trump has not “clearly explained the goals of U.S. military involvement in Iran.”
